question: Which of the following cities is set to host the COP30 climate summit in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Belem, Brazil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Belem, Brazil**, has been chosen to host the COP30 climate summit in 2025.
 
• The announcement was made by Brazil's President **Luis Inácio Lula da Silva** in 2023.
 
• Belem is located in the Amazon region, highlighting the significance of addressing climate change in one of the world's most critical ecosystems.
 
• The decision aligns with global efforts to focus on **preservation of the Amazon rainforest**, which plays a pivotal role in combating climate change.
 
• COP (Conference of the Parties) is an annual United Nations climate change conference where nations negotiate strategies to address global warming.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amazon Rainforest**: Known as the "lungs of the Earth," it produces 20% of the world's oxygen and is a critical carbon sink, absorbing large amounts of CO2.
 
• **COP Conferences**: These events are part of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), established in 1992 to combat climate change globally.
 
• **Brazil's Environmental Role**: Brazil is home to approximately 60% of the Amazon rainforest, making it a key player in global climate discussions.
 
• **Previous COP Locations**: Recent COP summits include COP26 in Glasgow, UK (2021), and COP27 in Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt (2022). COP28 is scheduled for Dubai, UAE, in 2023.
 
• **Deforestation Concerns**: The Amazon faces significant threats from deforestation and illegal mining, which contribute to biodiversity loss and increased greenhouse gas emissions.
